name: CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet
author: cyberforest

sections.description:
CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet adds a Guitar Chord Sheet block to the block editor.
Enter chord markers anywhere in the lyrics, for example:

[C]Your lyrics [G/B]continue here

For a custom fingering, enter six strings from low E to high E:

[Cadd9|x,3,2,0,3,3]Your lyrics

Enter [N.C.] to show a no-chord section. The free plugin always displays
diagrams. The optional Pro add-on can provide readers with diagram and
chord-names-only display buttons on the published page.

Use x for a muted string, 0 for an open string, and a number for a fret.
Diagrams are generated as accessible inline SVG and remain sharp at any size.

Built-in minor seventh diagrams include natural, sharp, and flat names such as
Am7, C#m7, Dbm7, Ebm7, and Bbm7. Use the lowercase letter b when
entering a flat chord name.

The plugin includes the Freemius SDK for optional usage tracking, account
management, add-on discovery, licensing, and updates. Freemius does not receive
data unless an administrator explicitly opts in. The chord sheet and its saved
content continue to work when tracking is skipped.

CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet is licensed under GPLv2 or later. The bundled
Freemius WordPress SDK is licensed under GPLv3; its license is included at
vendor/freemius/LICENSE.txt. No remote fonts, images, or icon sets are loaded.

Privacy

CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet does not transmit chord-sheet content. It includes
the Freemius SDK, which offers an administrator an explicit opt-in before sending
site and plugin usage information to Freemius. Skipping the opt-in does not disable
the free block or its saved content. If the administrator opts in, accepts an
offer, activates a license, or uses an account feature, the applicable information
is handled by Freemius under its privacy policy and terms.

Freemius privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet.
  3. Add the Guitar Chord Sheet block to a post or page.
  4. Enter lyrics and chord markers in the block.
sections.faq:
Which chords are built in?

Version 0.1.1 includes common major, minor, seventh, major seventh, minor
seventh, and selected slash chord fingerings. Minor seventh fingerings support
natural roots and sharp/flat aliases.

How do I enter sharp and flat chord names?

Use # for a sharp and the lowercase letter b for a flat. For example,
enter [C#m7] or [Dbm7]. The plugin treats supported enharmonic names as
aliases for the same fingering.

Can I create a custom chord?

Yes. Use [Name|string1,string2,string3,string4,string5,string6].
Strings are ordered from low E to high E.
sections.changelog:
0.3.0

  • Add the opt-in Freemius SDK integration for future Pro add-on licensing and updates.
  • Document Freemius data handling and the bundled SDK license.

0.2.3

  • Move shifted-position fret numbers below the diagram and show the visible fret range.
  • Keep the left boundary thin when a diagram starts above the first fret.

0.2.2

  • Add sharp and flat enharmonic diagrams for common major, minor, seventh, major seventh, and minor seventh chords.
  • Add missing natural F minor and G minor diagrams.

0.2.1

  • Add explicit N.C. (no chord) notation.
  • Keep the free edition in diagram display mode.

0.1.1

  • Rename the plugin to CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet and update its text domain for the requested WordPress.org slug.

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Add a dynamic Guitar Chord Sheet block for the visual editor.
  • Render accessible SVG chord diagrams above lyrics.
  • Include common chords, slash chords, and natural/sharp/flat minor seventh chords.
  • Support custom six-string fingerings.
